thread:
maya: quick heads-up — during qx4b-int4 bring-up we saw a small but worrying regression on our RAG bench (recall down ~3%, hallucination up on citation tasks). reproducing locally now :mag:
leila: ugh, thanks for flagging. is this on long-context samples or short? any tokenizer mismatch warnings? :eyes:
dave: I ran a few eval slices already — looks like long-context (>=2k) plus multi-step chain-of-thought style prompts. also a cluster of failures where retrieved doc ids are correct but model invents an extra sentence not in doc. nina: could be kv-cache rollout bug with int4 kernels? remember last time KV offsets shifted with the new kernel picker.
maya: good call. no explicit tokenizer errors, but the failure set overlaps with samples that hit cross-batch prefix caching. i'm going to re-run with prefix caching disabled to rule that out.
eval-bot: summary: qx4b-int4 vs q8b-baseline on rag_v1: recall 0.873 -> 0.845, hallucination rate +4.2pp on citation tasks (n=1200). p95 latency stable.
leila: if caching is the trigger we should triage whether it's runtime or quantization artifact. can you dump kv-cache hashes for failing traces? dave: do you have a quick kube job for that?
dave: yep, i'll spin a debug job. command i'm using:
``
kubectl run -i --restart=Never kv-debug --image=redwood-debug:rc -- /bin/bash -lc "python /app/trace_kv.py --model qx4b-int4 --sample-list failing_ids.txt --dump-kv"
``
kevin: putting label team on notice — if we need a golden refresh, we might need a quick relabel wave. what's the expected size of failing cluster?
maya: failing cluster ~240 samples after de-dupe (fingerprint-based). but raw hitset ~600 before de-dupe. many are paraphrase-near-duplicates; dedupe threshold might be masking the real regression.
label-coordinator: we can turn up a 48hr relabel sprint for ~300 microgolden if you confirm list. want us to prioritize citation correctness + hallucination flags?
nina: please include the retrieved doc snippet + model output for each sample in the label job. that makes it faster for labelers to mark hallucination vs extractive mismatch.
leila: question — could tokenizer vocabulary differences between qx4b quantized weights and q8b have changed byte-pair splits? I thought tokenizer is frozen, but worth verifying hash of tokenizer.json across builds.
dave: verified tokenizer hash identical across builds. so not tokenizer. re-running with prefix cache off now.
maya: status update in ~30m. if cache-off fixes it, plan: 1) collect failing traces -> reproduce in unit test harness, 2) run small-scale quant-calibration (re-run per-layer calibration on failing ops), 3) if still fails, fresh golden relabel pass for the 300 microgolden, flagged for hallucination.
eval-bot: also flag: embed recall on locator_tiny dropped by 2.1% in same slice. could be rerank interaction w/ quantized logits precision.
kevin: ack. label-coordinator, tentatively greenlight 48hr relabel if triage shows runtime not guilty.
label-coordinator: noted. i'll prep a relabel bundle template with fields: sample_id, retrieved_doc, model_output, golden_label_options (correct/extractive/partial/hallucination), priority=high. ETA for bundle ~2h.
maya: thanks all. if anyone wants to join the debug job dave started, ping me and i'll share access. :thumbsup:
leila: +1 to adding a deterministic unit test for this, fragile edge of caching+quant is a recurring pattern. can we also snapshot kernels used for failing ops? that helped before.
dave: adding kernel snapshot to debug run. will post logs when done.
maya: closing loop later with final decision (calibration vs golden refresh).
